name: Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, audio-in / text-out, general audio understanding rather than pure ASR (it handles voice chat and open-ended audio analysis, not just transcription). (1) AUDIO ENCODER (the compute-heavy part): audio_config is a WHISPER-LARGE ENCODER verbatim -- d_model 1280, encoder_layers 32, encoder_attention_heads 20, encoder_ffn_dim 5120, gelu, num_mel_bins 128, max_source_positions 1500. Qwen reused Whisper's audio front-end rather than training a new one. Confirmed independently from tensor shapes: audio_tower.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight is [1280,1280] and layers.31 likewise, so the encoder really is 32 layers at d_model 1280. AUDIO TOKENS: 1,500 encoder positions per 30s window. NO KV CACHE for the encoder -- single bidirectional pass. (2) LLM: Qwen2-7B dense decoder. IMPORTANT: text_config in this repo OMITS num_attention_heads and num_key_value_heads, so these were read from safetensors tensor shapes in the repo: language_model.model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight is [4096,4096] and k_proj.weight is also [4096,4096] at layers 0, 7 AND 31 -- K is NOT narrowed, so this is plain MHA with 32 heads of head_dim 128, no GQA and no MQA. lm_head [156032,4096] confirms hidden 4096 and vocab 156,032; layers.31.mlp.gate_proj [11008,4096] confirms intermediate 11,008 and 32 layers. Method note: this tensor-shape method was validated against Qwen2.5-VL-7B (k_proj [512,3584] = exactly 4 KV heads x 128) and Kimi-Audio (k_proj [512,3584], matching its declared 4 KV heads) before being used to conclude MHA here. activation is NULL because text_config states no hidden_act. ARCHITECTURE = dense. use_mrope false. KV CACHE: 32 * 32 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 524,288 B/token = 512 KiB/token. THIS IS THE LARGEST KV-PER-TOKEN OF ANY RECORD IN THIS SLICE, by 33% over the next worst (Phi-3.5-vision and Gemma 3 12B at 393,216 B). Full MHA on a 7B model is an unusually costly choice in 2024-25 and it is a direct consequence of the text_config omitting the GQA fields. At 8,192 ctx a single request pins 4.0 GiB of KV, and because the 1,500 audio positions are an LLM prefix, a 30s audio prompt already commits 1,500 * 524,288 = 750 MiB before any text is generated. STREAMING: OFFLINE -- bidirectional Whisper encoder, fixed 30s window. params_b 8.397 = HF API safetensors total (8,397,094,912).
